concerns.text: graph.schema.yaml specifies node features '[N_nodes, 10]' and edge features '[N_edges, 5]', but plan.md (T013d) and research.md §3.1 define exactly 5 node features (atomic number, electronegativity, covalent radius, group, period) and 2 edge features (distance, electronegativity difference). The contract contradicts the plan's feature dimensions; either the contract is stale or the plan under-specifies the feature set.

predictions.schema.yaml is truncated/corrupt: 'true_shear: description: "True ..."' followed by a comment and no required list, no additionalProperties, and a typo 'pred_yyoung'. It describes a 'predictions.csv' that no plan element produces (the plan writes predictions.json per predictions_schema.yaml). This orphaned, malformed contract disagrees with the data model and should be removed or completed.

dataset.schema.yaml describes 'filtered_materials.csv' with family values 'TMD, MXene, Oxide', but the plan/data-model define family as 'space group + stoichiometry class' and produce no filtered_materials.csv. Orphaned contract with a conflicting family definition; no plan element exercises it.

quickstart stage 9 names 'code/utils/compute_hashes.py' as the hash script, but plan task T001c ('Compute and record content hashes') names no script. Minor naming drift; align the plan task with the quickstart script path.
